user.description: Enter your Fairland iGarden app credentials. This integration supports Fairland pool heat pumps and pool pumps (including OEM-rebadged variants such as Madimack) and only works with the **iGarden app**, not the SmartPool app. Your account's server region (EU/US/HK/CN) is detected automatically.
